Claim 1 (Currently Amended): An immunogenic composition comprising: a modified, live bovine viral diarrhea virus type lb (BVDV-lb) __that is cytopathic__, a veterinary-acceptable carrier, and optionally an adjuvant.

Claim 3 (Currently Amended): The immunogenic composition of claim 1, __wherein the modified, live bovine viral diarrhea virus type lb is the sole BVDV species present in the composition, and__ further comprising one or more of a parainfluenza virus Type 3 (PI3), a bovine respiratory syncytial virus (BRSV), a bovine herpes virus (BHV-1), a bovine viral diarrhea virus Type la (BVDV-la), a bovine viral diarrhea virus Type 2 (BVDV-2), or an infectious bovine rhinotracheitis (IBR) virus, or any combination thereof; or one or more viral-specific antigens obtained therefrom.

Claim 4 (Currently Amended): The immunogenic composition of claim 1, __wherein the modified, live BVDV-lb virus is cytopathic, and__ further comprising a modified, live IBRV, a modified, live BRSV, a modified, live BHV-1, a modified, live BVDV Type la, a modified, live BVDV Type 2, or a modified, live PI3, or a combination thereof.

Claim 6 (Currently Amended): The immunogenic composition of claim 1, __wherein the modified, live BVDV-lb virus is cytopathic, and the composition__ further comprises an immunologically effective amount of at least a first antigen.

Claim 7 (Currently Amended): The immunogenic composition of claim 6, wherein the at least a first antigen is __a live attenuated or inactivated antigen specific__ for an organism selected from the group consisting of Actinobacillus, Actinomyces, Bacillus, Bordetella, Brachyspira, Campylobacter, Clostridium, Ehrlichia, Erysipelothrix, Escherichia, Histophilus, Leptospira, Listeria, Mannheimia, Moraxella, Mycobacterium, Mycoplasma, Pasteurella, Salmonella, and Streptococcus, or a combination thereof.

Claim 8 (Currently Amended): The immunogenic composition of claim 6, wherein the at least a first antigen is __a live attenuated or__ inactivated.

Claim 12 (Currently Amended): The vaccine of claim 4, __wherein the composition comprises a cytopathic modified, live BVDV-lb virus and__ further comprising an immunologically-effective amount of a least one microbial pathogen-specific antigen.
